# Immutable OSCAL v1.2.0 Compatibility Fixtures

These files are retained input evidence for PRD054. They are not generated-current golden files and must continue to declare `metadata.oscal-version` as `1.2.0`.

Do not refresh these files when `OSCAL_VERSION` or generated snapshots change. Tests may copy them to temporary locations, validate them against the pinned v1.2.3 compatibility schema, and export them across the paths that already support each model.
